options.name: chdir
options.description: Run the command from this (remote) directory.

options.name: command
options.description: The command line to run through PsExec (limited to 260 characters).

options.name: elevated
options.description: Run the command with elevated privileges.

options.name: executable
options.description: The location of the PsExec utility (in case it is not located in your PATH).

options.name: hostnames
options.description: The hostnames to run the command. If not provided, the command is run locally.

options.name: interactive
options.description: Run the program so that it interacts with the desktop on the remote system.

options.name: limited
options.description: Run the command as limited user (strips the Administrators group and allows only privileges assigned to the Users group).

options.name: nobanner
options.description: Do not display the startup banner and copyright message. This only works for specific versions of the PsExec binary.

options.name: noprofile
options.description: Run the command without loading the account's profile.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the (remote) user to run the command as. This is mandatory in order authenticate yourself.

options.name: priority
options.description: Used to run the command at a different priority.

options.name: session
options.description: Specifies the session ID to use. This parameter works in conjunction with I(interactive). It has no effect when I(interactive) is set to C(no).

options.name: system
options.description: Run the remote command in the System account.

options.name: username
options.description: The (remote) user to run the command as. If not provided, the current user is used.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the application to terminate. Only use for non-interactive applications.
